name: Yommi Rush
review:
A cosy cluster game about a friendly alien house spirit who shares multipliers when you feed him candy.

Three Yommis in one spin give 12 Classic Free Spins, and there's a separate Exclusive Free Spins mode with its own trigger. Medium-low volatility, a 2,000x max and 96.32% RTP, with free spins about once every 167 spins. Relaxed and charming.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
